{{Top|leg}}
A '''High Trough''' was a ceremonial basin used by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] during festivals and wedding ceremonies. Food such as creamed [[fug]] was placed in the trough and participants were encouraged to spread its contents on their friends.
